lines.en: Ugh.
What?
That's like the third time that lady's won on a machine I was playing.
Oh? I'll bet she's one of those people.
Mall people?
What? No, no. A lurker.
Ugh. What's a lurker?
Okay, when you're playing a machine and it hasn't paid out,
a lurker waits for you to give up and then...
Kills you?
No. They swoop in and steal your jackpot.
Oh. How do you know about this?
My nana used to do it.
That's how she paid for all my dance karate lessons.
Dance karate?
Yes. It's a deadly but beautiful sport.
Something your kiss just told me
My sunshine
Oh, well. Lost again.
That's it! You and me! Outside!
I don't wanna see you lose a chunk of that pretty blonde hair.
Oh!
Be cool.
Okay, lady, your lurking days are over.
What?
Yeah, from now on, everyone you lurk, I'm gonna lurk first.
If you move on to someone else, I'm gonna be one step ahead of you every single time.
And then I'll be on your ass every hour of every day till Monday.
Cause that's when I go home.
When do you leave?
Also Monday.
What time? Maybe we can share a cab.
Maybe we can share a cab.
Maybe we can share a cab.
